title: The Deductible Actually Withheld from a Travel Protection Plans Settlement
content:
These questions are answered for the deductible withheld from a settlement on a Travel Protection Plans certificate, once the deductible the benefit calls for has been settled. What remains of the plan's ceiling is the plan's ceiling on deductibles withheld per policy less the deductibles already withheld from the certificate's settled payments in this policy term.

**Where the certificate has settled a payment in this policy term and what remains of the plan's ceiling is less than the deductible the benefit calls for, what is the deductible withheld?**

The deductible withheld is what remains of the plan's ceiling.

**Where the certificate has settled a payment in this policy term and what remains of the plan's ceiling is the deductible the benefit calls for or more, what is the deductible withheld?**

The deductible withheld is the deductible the benefit calls for.

**Where neither of those holds, what is the deductible withheld?**

The deductible withheld is the deductible the benefit calls for taken once for each insured traveller named on the certificate.

## The three cases

| Payments settled on the certificate in this policy term | What remains of the plan's ceiling, against the deductible the benefit calls for | Deductible withheld |
| --- | --- | --- |
| At least 1 | Less than it | What remains of the plan's ceiling |
| At least 1 | Equal to it or more | The deductible the benefit calls for |
| None | — | The deductible the benefit calls for, taken once for each insured traveller named |

**Where does the boundary between the first two cases fall?**

At equality. Where what remains of the plan's ceiling is exactly the deductible the benefit calls for, the second case applies and the whole of that deductible is withheld; the first case requires what remains to be strictly less.

**The plan's ceiling on deductibles withheld per policy stands at which figures?**

At 300.00 USD on Trip Basics Essential, 225.00 USD on Trip Basics Standard, 150.00 USD on TripGuard Plus and on Annual Multi-Trip Traveller, and 0.00 USD on TripGuard Premier, on Cancel For Any Reason Elite and on Annual Multi-Trip Executive.

**On a certificate with no payment settled in this policy term, why is the number of insured travellers reached?**

Because the third case is the one that applies, and it takes the deductible the benefit calls for once for each insured traveller named on the certificate. Hypothetically, a deductible of 50.00 USD on a certificate naming 3 travellers is withheld as 150.00 USD.
